dict.string: Banana Beta plays a playlist, album, or song from your Apple Music library when a routine starts.
Banana Beta uses the camera only when you choose to photograph a meal or a supplement label, or scan a barcode.
Banana Beta looks up the people you type when adding guests to an event, so “Lunch with Sam” can invite the Sam you mean.
Banana Beta reads your workouts and health metrics from Apple Health so it can show and analyze your fitness in one place.
Banana Beta saves workouts to Apple Health and updates them when you trim a workout.
Banana finds your other Banana devices on this Wi-Fi so one downloaded podcast file can be reused without downloading it again.
Banana uses your location for your local forecast.
Banana Beta records quick voice notes when you ask it to.
Banana Beta looks for photos of meals — only when you turn on Find meal photos automatically — so it can ask what you ate and log it.
Banana reads your reminders on-device so it can schedule tasks onto your day.
Banana transcribes downloaded episodes on your device.
